notes: Built from the two Fritzing images: the RC circuit (LDR + capacitor) plus the buzzer circuit shown together in the second image. Breadboard rows f-j are the 'b' bank in the catalogue naming.

Wiring: 3V3.1 -> col 1; LDR from col 1 to col 3; capacitor positive in col 3, negative in col 5; GPIO4 -> col 3 (LDR/capacitor junction); GND.1 -> col 5. Buzzer: positive (red lead, col 30) -> GPIO17, negative (black lead, col 29) -> GND.2 (pin 9).
The 1uF capacitor is modelled with the catalogue type capacitor-10uf (polarized POS/NEG) with value=1uF; no 1uF type exists.
Buzzer port 1 is assumed to be the positive (red) lead and port 2 the negative lead.
The Pi header pins were identified from the images: top-right pin is 3V3.1 (pin 1), GPIO4 is pin 7, GND.1 pin 6, GPIO17 pin 11, GND.2 pin 9.

The laser pointer, drinking straw (LDR shield), the speaker alternative, the optional jumper-lead assembly (socket-pin/socket-socket leads, tape) and the software steps are not in the circuit images and were left out.
